fieldValues.title: Grid census cycle three (2026-09-06), corrected read-out
fieldValues.summary: srs#635 asked for "cycle two" diffed against census-2026-08-26.json, but PR #582 had already run cycle two (diffed against 08-26) the evening before the issue was filed. Ran the genuine next cycle instead -- cycle three, diffed against the real prior cycle (09-05) -- corpus moved 238->247 (RFC-034's Container fold: six new invariants, all `containment`, +7 there; four new decisions split none/containment/succession/governance). Gave a one-line proposal for all 21 none-placements (not just a class summary) and corrected the "four unguarded cells" figure to three (portability picked up a check independently since cycle two), with a smallest-honest-check proposal for each of the three. No conformance-rule changes -- proposals only.
